paper: Certified Tsirelson bounds for 229 tight bipartite Bell inequalities
convention: violation = <psi|W|psi> - b0 with W = sum_x bA[x] A_x + sum_y bB[y] B_y + sum_xy bAB[x][y] A_x B_y (Collins-Gisin form, projectors A_x, B_y); local bound 0
lower_bound: exact strategy: projectors V (V^dag V)^-1 V^dag from the given spanning vectors, state psi; violation_exact is the exact rational value
upper_bound: sum_ij Y_ij w_i^* w_j = lambda 1 - W in the universal projector algebra and Y + tau_stated I >= 0 imply <W> <= lambda + n_words * tau_stated for every commuting-operator strategy; bound_exact = lambda + n_words * tau_stated - b0, tau_stated = sigma + residual (binary64 values given exactly in hex)
printed_values: window.lower = violation rounded down to 1e-10, window.upper = bound rounded up to 1e-10
